payload.title: Why a partial view is more dangerous than no view
payload.question: script sees only some files and reports success
payload.symptom: A scan or sync reports clean results that are quietly wrong.
payload.cause: Recent macOS blocks scheduled jobs from protected directories, and the block presents as absence rather than as a permission error. Code that sees half a directory concludes the other half does not exist.
payload.measured: A convergence loop declared success against a filesystem it could only partly read.
payload.fix: Make jobs assert what they could not read, and refuse to conclude when the evidence is incomplete. Report degraded rather than clean.
payload.why_it_matters: No answer is recoverable. A confident wrong answer propagates into everything downstream that trusted it.
